specification.evaluation_timing: Grade only provider-completed games after scheduled start; preserve result versions; primary forecast selected independently of results. No retrospective backfills.
specification.exclusions: No primary-window forecast, source/model drift, insufficient training, invalid identity, rescheduled start, incomplete/nonregular result, unresolved scoring identity. No exclusion based on forecast correctness.
specification.first_shot_target: First FG attempt before first score; known nonselected shooters count as misses
specification.inclusion: Real NBA regular-season completed games; immutable forecast after registration and before tip; 10 valid current-roster identities; at least 100 earlier training games; resolved actual scorer. All lineup evidence cohorts retained and reported separately.
specification.interim_policy: Operational/descriptive only. No promotion or refitting at interim looks; continued looks are not independent tests.
specification.intervals: Paired bootstrap of game-date clusters, 1000 draws, existing compare_evaluations fixed seed; report sample sizes and zero-probability outcomes without epsilon smoothing
specification.precision_plan: At 300 games and 15% accuracy, normal-reference half-width is about 4.0 percentage points. Paired score precision depends on observed variance and date clustering. Continue if uncertainty remains; do not treat 300 as sufficient evidence of an edge.
specification.primary_comparison: Pure Monte Carlo minus Baseline + Other
specification.primary_selection: Latest archived forecast generated 30–600 seconds before the unchanged scheduled start; one per game, chosen without results
specification.secondary_comparisons: Calibrated baseline, simple proxy, hybrid and uniform versus Baseline + Other; exploratory and unadjusted
specification.unresolved_policy: Existing baseline fallback followed by explicit Other allocation
specification.unverified_policy: Include as research in projected/manual/incomplete cohorts; no actionable recommendation. Missing injuries are flagged, not silently treated as healthy.
